conversation_id.description: The conversation to report on, which is the `$ai_session_id` its generations carry: the Max conversation for a chat, the task for an agent run. Omitted, the report covers the team only.

conversation_started_at.description: When the conversation started. Only a Max conversation can be looked up here, so a caller that knows its own start time passes it; without one the reported period bounds the search and a conversation older than the period is undercounted.

product.description: The `ai_product` of the calling surface, e.g. `slack_app` or `posthog_code`. Adds a row for what that product alone spent. A product with no credit counter is reported as null.
